published.title: Decoding Backend Integration through Venn Diagrams: From Simplicity to Multi-Dimensional Thinking
published.plain_summary: Backend integration can be easier to reason about when the relationships between systems, responsibilities, and shared interfaces are represented visually.
published.so_what: You don't need more abstractions to understand backend integration — you need a better map of which systems share what.
published.result: A conceptual approach to explaining backend integration through Venn diagrams. No experimental validation claimed.
